svg.text: Āₜ = exp(Δₜ A), B̃ₜ = Δₜ Bₜ
Left: mixer only; outer block norm and residual are omitted. Right: recurrence detail.
Conv cache and SSM state are updated, not appended like full-context KV. ⊙ / × denote elementwise multiplication.
